prompts:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production inventory icon atlas for an island survival WebGL game with a simple low-poly tropical world and dark olive UI. Clean handcrafted low-poly 3D illustrated game item icons, chunky angular faceted forms, restrained warm wood ochre, rope beige, slate stone, ivory cloth, olive foliage, blue water, warm orange fire. Soft upper-left lighting, crisp silhouette, subtle dark contour, minimal texture. Readable at 24-40 pixels. No photorealism, no emoji style, no pixels. EXACTLY 5 columns by 5 rows equal square invisible cells, one centered isolated icon per cell. Objects fill central 70% of cell, ample uniform padding all sides. All icons same camera 3/4 slightly above. Miniature buildings are inventory symbols, not environment sprites. No ground planes, cast shadows, text, letters, labels, frames, borders or UI. Flat solid #FF00FF magenta background throughout for chroma key, no magenta within objects. Read row-major left to right then downward. CRITICAL exact 25 icons, 5 in EVERY row. No extra rocks. Explicit row assignments:
ROW 1: (1) bundle of wood logs, (2) ONE gray stone, (3) rope coil, (4) wood barrel, (5) half coconut.
ROW 2: (1) raw silver fish, (2) cooked meat on leaf, (3) blue water bottle, (4) crab claw meat, (5) raw pink bird drumstick.
ROW 3: (1) raw red boar steak, (2) medicinal leafy herb, (3) cream bandage roll, (4) tied green plant fibers, (5) iron ore rock with silver flecks.
ROW 4: (1) copper ore rock orange flecks, (2) silver metal ingot, (3) orange copper ingot, (4) charcoal, (5) metal scrap pile.
ROW 5: (1) copper wire coil, (2) tan carrot seeds in open tiny pouch with orange carrot motif NO TEXT, (3) dark herb seeds in open tiny pouch with green leaf, (4) orange carrot, (5) dark smoked fish fillet on leaf.
Do NOT add objects or change ordering. Equal square cells. Each icon fully inside central 75 percent of its cell.
